solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Diminutive client in brothel is big man in 7

definitions.note: 7 is the forest entry; Robin Hood's giant companion lived there

parts.note: diminutive means small, little
a john is slang for a prostitute's client

explanation.surface: A puny customer at a bordello turns out to be a big shot somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 7 refers to FOREST, so the big man is one of Robin Hood's band in Sherwood Forest, ironically nicknamed for his size.
explanation.definitionFit: Robin Hood's huge lieutenant in Sherwood Forest carries this joking nickname.

clue.text: Informer stopped by those working for Resistance

indicators.note: the informer word is plugged in its middle by the other piece

parts.note: a rat is an informer, a grass

indicators.note: working means the letters of 'those' are set in motion, rearranged

explanation.surface: A wartime traitor is thwarted by the fighters of the Resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resistance' looks like the wartime underground, and 'working' like the fighters' activity; here it is electrical resistance and an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: This device is a variable resistor, used to control current in a circuit.

clue.text: Quiller Memorandum could one produce

parts.note: The Quiller Memorandum is a spy novel; the person who could produce it is an author

explanation.surface: A question of who could have produced the spy thriller The Quiller Memorandum.
explanation.walkthrough: The Quiller Memorandum is a 1965 spy novel by Adam Hall, later filmed; 'Quiller' also hints at a quill, a pen.
explanation.definitionFit: An author is the person who produces a novel such as this one.

clue.text: Successful stroke from firm now more valued in FTSE?

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a share whose price has risen is up

explanation.surface: A company's shares rising on the stock exchange is a successful stroke.
explanation.walkthrough: The FTSE is the main index of shares on the London Stock Exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: A masterstroke or triumph is called this, as in pulling off a real one.

clue.text: Speculator, ace, returned in happy state around five

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap round the five

parts.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace

indicators.note: happy suggests merry, tipsy, so the letters are knocked about

parts.note: taken as written for rearrangement
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A financial speculator, holding an ace, comes back happy with five.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' looks like a reversal, but it is fodder: 'in happy state' scrambles A and RETURNED into ADENTURER, and 'around' puts that round V.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes financial risks for profit is called this, a gambling speculator.

clue.text: Prince appearing at the end eats rook and turtle part

indicators.note: the phrase for appearing at the end swallows the chess piece letter

parts.note: an act appearing at the end of the bill is last on
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A prince who turns up last dines on rook, followed by part of a turtle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last on' is how a show's final act is described.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the flat underside shell of a turtle or tortoise.

clue.text: Following others to stay over in green area

indicators.note: the over letter goes inside the other two pieces, staying there

parts.note: f is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
the rest means the others
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Following the others, you stay over in a park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to stay' simply says the O remains lodged inside F and REST.
explanation.definitionFit: A large wooded tract of land is a green area on any map.

clue.text: Pair in which old man retains pant-front shape?

indicators.note: the father word keeps the letter held within it

parts.note: old man is slang for father, dad
Y-fronts are men's underpants, named for the Y shape on the front

explanation.surface: A pair of underpants is kept by father, with their distinctive shape.
explanation.walkthrough: Y-fronts are a British brand-name for men's briefs with an inverted Y seam at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of two, a couple, is the technical sense of this word.

clue.text: 3 1 7 in Nottinghamshire also hires out club

indicators.note: out means the letters of hires are put out of order

parts.note: a wood is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A Nottinghamshire golfer hires a club for a round.
explanation.walkthrough: Two wordplays: '1 7 in Nottinghamshire' is I (1) and SHERWOOD (the 7, FOREST, of Nottinghamshire); 'also' introduces the second, anagram of HIRES plus WOOD. 3 is WRITER.
explanation.definitionFit: Christopher Isherwood was an English novelist, author of Goodbye to Berlin.

clue.text: Mad Percy eviscerated going after game

indicators.note: the gutted name follows the game in the answer

parts.note: loo is an old card game

indicators.note: with its insides removed, only the outer letters of the name remain

explanation.surface: Crazy Percy gets disembowelled after a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Loopy is informal for crazy, a bit unhinged.

clue.text: Favourite pig close to sentient revived old dance

indicators.note: the close of the word sentient is its final letter
revived, as if reshaped, the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
a sow is a female pig

explanation.surface: A beloved pig, nearly sentient, is brought back to life to perform an old-fashioned dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revived' rearranges PETSOWT.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballroom dance in quick march time, popular in the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Devil won't need Black Death area in London

indicators.note: the devil word does without the letter for black

parts.note: the Beast is a name for the Devil, from Revelation
B is the pencil abbreviation for black
end means death

explanation.surface: The Devil won't require the Black Death to devastate a district of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Black Death' looks like one plague; split it: Black gives B, Death gives END.
explanation.definitionFit: The district east of the City of London, home of the Cockney, has this name.

clue.text: Leader in Aerosmith quits festival compound

indicators.note: the leader leaves the festival word

parts.note: Easter is a Christian festival

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The frontman of the rock band Aerosmith quits a music festival.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical compound formed from an acid and an alcohol goes by this name.

clue.text: Such fat as may cause disease is dripping

definitions.text: Such fat as may cause disease
definitions.meaning: a kind of fat linked to heart disease in health warnings

explanation.surface: A health warning that this fat can cause disease, and it is dripping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dripping' looks like the noun, beef fat, but it is the adjective, soaking wet.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal fats with no double bonds are this kind, and anything soaked through is too.

clue.text: Austrian scorer to live invested in groschen which is crazy

definitions.note: a scorer is a composer, one who writes scores

indicators.note: the living word is placed inside the jumbled coin name
crazy means the letters of groschen run wild

parts.note: to be is to live, exist

explanation.surface: An Austrian composer will live invested in groschen, which is mad.
explanation.walkthrough: The groschen was a small Austrian coin. 'crazy' turns it into SCHOENRG, with BE inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold Schoenberg was the Austrian composer who pioneered twelve-tone music.

clue.text: Departure where King George breathes his last outside holy city

indicators.note: the dying word goes round the royal cipher

parts.note: to breathe one's last is to die, so he dies
GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
Sion is a variant of Zion, Jerusalem the holy city

explanation.surface: A departure: where King George breathes his last outside the holy city.
explanation.definitionFit: A digression is a departure from the main subject.

clue.text: Huguenot in front posed no threat

indicators.note: posed, as arranged in a new position, signals rearranging the letters

explanation.surface: A French Protestant at the head of things posed no danger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'posed no threat' reads as one phrase, but 'posed' is the anagram signal and 'no threat' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A contender with no chance of winning is described this way, harmless.

clue.text: Being kind vergers in Foula, they must hold hands

indicators.note: vergers playfully means verges, the edges, so the outer letters of the island name
the pronoun they has to grip the hands inside it

parts.note: R and L stand for right and left hands

explanation.surface: Church vergers on the Shetland island of Foula must hold hands to be kind.
explanation.walkthrough: Foula is a remote island in Shetland. 'vergers' puns on verges, edges, giving FA.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindly and protective in the manner of a dad, as a parent would be.

clue.text: Irritating as first part in Dantean work

definitions.text: as first part in Dantean work
definitions.meaning: Inferno is the first part of Dante's Divine Comedy, so the adjective relating to it

explanation.surface: Something irritating, like the first part of Dante's great work.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means hellish, so both fiendishly annoying and relating to Dante's Hell.

clue.text: Dark clothing

parts.note: dark is the night-time
wear means clothing, as in menswear

explanation.surface: Simply a description of sombre-coloured clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests black garments; read cryptically it is clothing for the dark hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyjamas and nightgowns are clothes worn in bed after dark.

clue.text: Crowd with Paul's inside for cake

parts.note: a gate is the crowd attending a sports match

indicators.note: the inside of the name is its middle letters

explanation.surface: A crowd joins Paul indoors for cake.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich, elaborate cake, usually layered with cream, has this French name.

clue.text: Senior electrician, being short, makes tactless remark

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: the gaffer is the chief electrician on a film set

explanation.surface: A senior electrician, being curt, says something tactless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' looks like curt; it cuts the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy social blunder, such as an unthinking remark, is called this.

clue.text: Eight pints of something bitter available

parts.note: gall is bile, proverbially bitter
on means available, as in on tap

explanation.surface: Eight pints of bitter beer on tap at the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: The pub surface makes 'bitter' look like beer; it is gall.
explanation.definitionFit: An imperial unit of liquid measure equal to eight pints.

clue.text: More goes into personal best, this for season

definitions.note: the definition describes a plant used to season food

indicators.note: the word for more is placed inside the athletic abbreviation

parts.note: PB is the athlete's abbreviation for personal best
other means more, additional

explanation.surface: An athlete adds to a personal best during the season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'season' looks like a sporting season but is the cooking verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A leafy plant grown for flavouring cooking, used to season dishes.

clue.text: Send for servant-boy

definitions.meaning: to call someone over the loudspeaker is to summon them
a boy attendant at a hotel or court

explanation.definitionFit: To summon someone by announcement, and a young attendant or messenger.

clue.text: Slang used by gay son for weapon sailors unleash

parts.note: Polari is the slang once used by gay men in Britain

explanation.surface: Gay slang, used by a son, for a weapon sailors fire.
explanation.walkthrough: Polari was a British cant of theatre and gay subculture; many of its words came from sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: A submarine-launched nuclear missile once deployed by the Royal and US navies.

clue.text: Man and wife into god

indicators.note: the wife letter goes inside the god's name

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild

explanation.surface: A man and his wife are devoted to a god.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person; it is a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The humblest chess piece is called a man, as all pieces are.

clue.text: Liberal called about lump of wood

indicators.note: about means the word for called turns around

parts.note: rang means called on the phone

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician phoned about a lump of wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A knot or knobbly protuberance on a tree trunk goes by this name.

clue.text: Salad ingredient sent lead-free from Ottawa

indicators.note: sent, as in sent wild, sends the letters into a new order
free of its lead, the word loses its first letter

explanation.surface: A salad ingredient shipped unleaded from Ottawa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead-free' looks like petrol; it strips F from FROM, leaving ROM, which 'sent' mixes with OTTAWA.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncooked tomato is a typical salad ingredient.
